item.fluid.baton.tooltip.summary: Used to configure interaction points for Mechanical Arms and Pipettes
item.fluid.baton.tooltip.action1: Select target and enter configuration mode
item.fluid.baton.tooltip.action2: Add interaction point and cycle mode
item.fluid.waxed_cardboard.tooltip.summa: Test item. It will be released in the upcoming new mod 'Create: Over the Sea' in the future. Stay tuned.
item.fluid.worn_harpoon.tooltip.summary: An ancient, worn harpoon lost in the depths; polish it to restore its former gloss
item.fluid.copper_diving_leggings.toolti: Copper Diving Leggings used with diving boots to experience a moonwalk-like feeling underwater.
The wearer gains super jump ability in water, up to four blocks high, with no fall damage upon landing.
item.fluid.netherite_diving_leggings.too: Netherite Diving Leggings used with diving boots to experience a moonwalk-like feeling underwater or in lava seas.
The wearer gains super jump ability in water or lava, up to four blocks high, with no fall damage upon landing.
item.fluid.harpoon_pouch.tooltip.summary: Holds up to 4 harpoons. Automatically replenishes a harpoon to the main hand after throwing and prioritizes storing picked-up harpoons in the pouch.
item.fluid.pneumatic_harpoon_gun.tooltip: Powered by compressed air. Shoots a harpoon that pulls hit entities toward you or pulls you toward blocks. Can remotely collect items.
Shoots harpoon, right click again to draws it back
block.fluid.frame_trap.tooltip.behaviour: Captures nearby fish, or other small creatures, and items along the path. Also gains fishing loot from the current biome over time. Grants experience nuggets when fishing triggers or creatures are captured.
block.fluid.mesh_trap.tooltip.summary: Automatically collects nearby items, captures fish or other small creatures, and stores them. Note that the mesh trap does not have the ability to obtain fishing loot.
block.fluid.mesh_trap.tooltip.behaviour1: Capture specified entity, gain its loot and experience nuggets.
block.fluid.mesh_trap.tooltip.behaviour2: Extracts items, up to one stack at a time.
block.fluid.trap_nozzle.tooltip.summary: Attach to the front of an Encased Fan to distribute its effect on Entities in all directions.
block.fluid.trap_nozzle.tooltip.conditio: When attached to an encased fan:
block.fluid.trap_nozzle.tooltip.behaviou: Automatically collects nearby items, captures fish, or other small creatures, and stores them
Extracts items, up to one stack at a time.
block.fluid.smart_mesh.tooltip.summary: Smart Mesh automatically collects nearby items and stores them.
block.fluid.smart_mesh.tooltip.behaviour: Extracts items, up to one stack at a time.
block.fluid.smart_beehive.tooltip.summar: Test block, the functions are still under development. This block is not part of the content of this mod 'Create: Fishery Industry'. It will be released in the upcoming new mod 'Create: Dinner' in the future. Stay tuned.
block.fluid.mechanical_peeler.tooltip.su: A mechanical component for processing peeling recipes and interacting with certain entities
block.fluid.mechanical_peeler.tooltip.be: Processes peeling recipes, similar to a mechanical saw. Can shear sheep or harvest scutes from turtles and armadillos. Can strip bark from entire trees, remove rust and wax from blocks, and harvest mature amethyst clusters.
block.fluid.smart_nozzle.tooltip.summary: Smart Nozzle with filter capability that can automatically collect nearby items matching the filter criteria.
block.fluid.smart_nozzle.tooltip.conditi: When attached to an encased fan:
block.fluid.smart_nozzle.tooltip.behavio: Automatically collects nearby items matching the filter and stores them. Air flow only affects filtered items.
Extracts items, up to one stack at a time.
Place an item in the filter slot to collect only that type of item. Air flow will ignore non-matching items completely.
block.fluid.fluid_interface.tooltip.summ: A _proxy_ block for interfacing with adjacent fluid containers. Can be used to provide _precise positioning_ for automated fluid handling.
block.fluid.fluid_interface.tooltip.beha: Enables _Mechanical Pipettes_ and other automation to interact with the attached container through the interface.
Allows _direct fluid interaction_ with the attached container using buckets or fluid containers.
block.fluid.smart_fluid_interface.toolti: An _advanced proxy_ block for fluid containers with built-in _filtering capabilities_. Restricts which fluids can pass through.
Only allows _specified fluids_ to be inserted or extracted. Mechanical Pipettes will respect the filter settings.
Functions as a _filtered gateway_ to the attached container, preventing unwanted fluid types.
block.fluid.pipette.tooltip.summary: A _kinetic device_ for automated fluid transfer between containers. The fluid equivalent of the Mechanical Arm.
block.fluid.pipette.tooltip.behaviour1: _Automatically transfers fluids_ between configured input and output points. Supports _multiple interaction points_ and _selection modes_.
block.fluid.pipette.tooltip.behaviour2: Can _feed lava to Blaze Burners_ automatically and _extract honey from Beehives_ when they're full. Respects _Smart Fluid Interface filters_.
block.fluid.pipette.tooltip.behaviour3: Use the Pipette on _Fluid Interfaces_, _Basins_, _Beehives_, or _Blaze Burners_ to set up interaction points. Use _Wrench_ to modify selection modes.
create.fluid.mechanical_pipette.points_o: %1$s Fluid Interaction Points were removed because they are now out of range
create.fluid.mechanical_pipette.no_targe: It appears this _Mechanical_ _Pipette_ has not been assigned any _targets._ Select belts, depots, funnels and other blocks by _right-clicking_ them while _holding_ the _Mechanical_ _Pipette_ in your _hand_.
create.hint.mechanical_arm_no_targets: It appears this _Mechanical_ _Arm_ has not been assigned any _targets._ Select belts, depots, funnels and other blocks by _right-clicking_ them while _holding_ the _Mechanical_ _Arm_ in your _hand_.
create.create.mechanical_arm.points_outs: %1$s selected interaction point(s) removed due to range limitations.
create.create.mechanical_arm.summary: Mechanical Arm has %1$s input(s) and %2$s output(s).
